The Clerks Office Oversees and/or Provides the Following Services: Birth, Marriage, and Death records ( long-form only, certified copies are provided ) AMENDMENTS Will be completed by Appointment only to ensure privacy and proper completion. Can ONLY be done by either the State Division of Vital Records or by the City/Town in which: Person was Born for Birth Amendment Person passed away for Death Amendment The City/Town where the Marriage Intention was completed. CERTIFICATES for VITAL RECORDS Online : Before you place an Order, reach out to us to ensure that your document is on file in our office . Birth & Death Certificates are on file in the City/Town in which the person was: BIRTH:  Born or was a resident in when born DEATH: Passed away in or was a resident when they passed away. Marriage Certificates are available ONLY in the City/Town in which they filed for the Marriage Intentions In Person : Birth Certificates, Death Certificates and Marriage Certificates are ONLY available in the City/Town as listed above under online. By Mail : Please ensure first that we have your record that you wish to request.   A personal check, money order or bank check must be accompanied with the written request for the record with all information required, as well as a self addressed stamped envelope for the return of the Certificate. MARRIAGE INTENTIONS Will be completed by Appointment only to ensure privacy and proper completion. Billiard/Poolroom License Bowling Alley Licenses Business Licenses (DBA) Certified Copies of Cemetery Deeds Census also called "Annual Street Listing" (Annually from the City) (Every 10- Years from the Federal Government) If you DO NOT return your Annual City Census and are a voter, it will result in removal from the active voting list and may result in the removal from the voter registration rolls. City Charter/Ordinances Dog Licenses Elections - The City Clerk oversees each Election (Municipal; State and Federal) Coverage for Elections (Poll Workers) Information on and updates to each election Statement of Candidates for Elections Campaign Finance Reports (Local Candidates and Committees) Certification of Signatures for Nominations Certification of Signatures for Initiative Petitions Ethics Certifications (Conflict of Interest) Fuel Storage Certificates Genealogy Research Due to the time required for staff to complete genealogy research, an hourly fee and per-record charge will apply. Please note: Due to the high volume of requests, research may take 30 days or longer to complete. All requests are processed in the order they are received. Our office will contact the requestor if: we find there are inconsistencies between the Requestors information and what we have if we require more information to complete the research for you The research has been completed, to review and confirm findings A completed Genealogy Research Request Form is required before any research can begin. Form: Genealogy Research Request Form Email to: CityClerk@northadams-ma.gov Notary Services In accordance with Massachusetts Notarial Law, Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 222, a Notary Public will not provide service if the customer, document, or circumstances of the request for Notary service raise any issue of authenticity, ambiguity, doubt, or uncertainty.   In this event, the Notary may, at his/her sole discretion, decline to provide Notary Services. Open Meeting Law Information and tracking of Acknowledgements Pole Location Hearings/Orders Postings for Meetings & Minutes to Boards and Website Raffle & Bazaar Licenses Sunday Licenses Taxi Operators License & Taxi Driver Licenses Transient Vendor License Voter Registration, changes in Voter Registration, Absentee Voting Register to VOTE, Update Voter Information online Register to Vote or update Voter Registration Online Absentee Voting  Information  for  2026 Absentee Ballot Application Absentee Voting Information Mail in Voting  for  2026 Vote By Mail Accessible Application Regular - Vote by Mail Application Online Application Mail In Voting Information The City Clerk supports the City Council by providing the following: agenda preparation, recording minutes, letters, and archiving petitions, communications, orders, and ordinances, resolutions. PLEASE NOTE: The City Clerk's Office has a NO REFUND POLICY. A request for a record should only be made if you know that the City of North Adams has the record or have confirmed with the City Clerk's Office that the record exists in North Adams.
